usedFor: Asyntai AI Chatbot captures leads from your website chat, and Bolna calls each one through your Bolna account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Captured” in Asyntai AI Chatbot, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A lead that just filled in the chat gets a call while the interest is fresh.

watchOut: “Make a Phone Call” needs a number to dial, so check the captured lead carries a phone number.
